display.purpose: PT Serif headings, semibold, tight tracking.

body.purpose: Inter for reading text and for buttons.

shadows.name: dish
shadows.purpose: The plated recipe photo. Icon tiles and inputs stay flat.

motion.name: timer-flight
motion.purpose: The countdown chip flies from the duration in the step to the header.

motion.name: timer-wiggle
motion.purpose: A second tap on a running duration wiggles the floating timer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lime pill for import, start cooking, and login.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C3D56D; color: #40442A; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(195, 213, 109, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6A7147; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link input
components.description: Pill field for a recipe URL. No shadow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.25rem 0 3rem; border: 1px solid #D9CDB8; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #40442A; box-shadow: none; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6A655A; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #6A7147; border-color: #6A7147; }

components.name: Icon tile
components.description: Bordered cream tile. A lime disc stands in until the WebP is ready.
components.css: .ds-icon { width: 4rem; height: 4rem; border-radius: 1.75rem; background: #F6F9E8; border: 1px solid #E4D9C8; box-shadow: none; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-icon::before { content: ''; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #C3D56D; }

narrative.northStar: A recipe card on the counter
narrative.overview: Warm cream page, PT Serif headings, Inter body and buttons, lime pills for the main action, bordered ingredient tiles, and one soft shadow on the dish photo.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, no cards around the form or a step
PT Serif headings, Inter everywhere else
Lime #C3D56D actions, 3rem on import and 4rem while cooking
Bordered icon tiles, shadowed dish photo

rules.name: The Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime is the one action. Save is a ghost button. Back in a step is an outline button.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Headings use PT Serif. Body text and buttons use Inter.

dos: Use cream #F3EDE3 as the page and lime #C3D56D for the main action.
Center the home title, subtitle, and form together.
Keep Back and Next visible while a long step scrolls.
donts: Do not wrap the import flow or a cooking step in a card.
Do not put a shadow on inputs or icon tiles.
Do not set buttons in PT Serif.
Do not turn the duration in the step into a running clock.
